description: This file defines the ProjectActivityReport class, a report generator for project activity data within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for preparing filter parameters, validation rules, providing report headers, and fetching report data related to project activities. The class extends ProjectReport and uses traits and classes for internationalization, filtering, validation, and report data management. The file handles external dependencies such as request parameters, validators, project activity entities, and report-related classes.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReport
classes.description: A report class for generating project activity reports, extending ProjectReport and utilizing internationalization traits. It provides methods to prepare filtering parameters from API requests, define validation rules for report parameters, generate report headers, and fetch report data specific to project activities.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters for the report based on request query parameters, including project ID, activity ID, date ranges, and timesheet inclusion.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for report parameters, ensuring activity ID is positive and exists within the ProjectActivity entity.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the header columns for the report, including Employee Name and Time (Hours), with internationalized labels.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and returns report data based on provided filter parameters.
